# Packages
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

# Loading the phenotypic data
```{r}
# -9999 and -999 are ABIDE's codes for missing values -> read them as NA
ABIDE1_pheno <- read.csv("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/Phenotypic Data/ABIDEIPhenotypic_V1_0b.csv",
                         header = TRUE, na.strings = c("-9999", "-999"))

ABIDE2_pheno <- read.csv("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/Phenotypic Data/ABIDEIIPhenotypic.csv",
                         header = TRUE, na.strings = c("-9999", "-999"))



# Exclude longitudinal data from both datasets
exclude_ID_long <- c(50002,50005,50006,50007,50013,50026,50027,
                     50028,50029,50031,50035,50038,50047,
                     50048,50049,50050,50051) 

ABIDE1_pheno <- ABIDE1_pheno %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% exclude_ID_long)
ABIDE2_pheno <- ABIDE2_pheno %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% exclude_ID_long)

```

# 1) Coverage Check
```{r}

# Coverage file created with bash: lists subjects with < 90 % whole-brain coverage
lines <- readLines("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/VBM/coverage_all_90_WholeBrain.txt")

under90 <- grep("has less than 90%", lines, value = TRUE)
under90  # 14 subjects

# Extract the numeric subject IDs 
under90_ids <- sub(" has less than 90% coverage", "", under90)
under90_ids <- as.integer(sub(".*_", "", under90_ids))

sum(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID %in% under90_ids)  # sanity check: should be 14

ABIDE1_pheno <- ABIDE1_pheno[!(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID %in% under90_ids), ]

sum(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID %in% under90_ids)  # sanity check: should be 0

# Combine ABIDE I and II
# HANDEDNESS_CATEGORY and CURRENT_MED_STATUS have different types in the two datasets
# (integer vs. character), so convert both to character before binding
ABIDE1_pheno$HANDEDNESS_CATEGORY <- as.character(ABIDE1_pheno$HANDEDNESS_CATEGORY)
ABIDE2_pheno$HANDEDNESS_CATEGORY <- as.character(ABIDE2_pheno$HANDEDNESS_CATEGORY)

ABIDE1_pheno$CURRENT_MED_STATUS <- as.character(ABIDE1_pheno$CURRENT_MED_STATUS)
ABIDE2_pheno$CURRENT_MED_STATUS <- as.character(ABIDE2_pheno$CURRENT_MED_STATUS)

ABIDEall_pheno <- bind_rows(ABIDE1_pheno, ABIDE2_pheno)

nrow(ABIDEall_pheno) == nrow(ABIDE1_pheno) + nrow(ABIDE2_pheno)  # sanity check: should be TRUE
```

# 2) Exclusion based on IQR (CAT12 image quality rating)
```{r}
## ABIDE I
ABIDE1_IQR   <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/IQR/CAT12_IQR_ABIDE1.csv', header = TRUE)  # IQR values extracted from the CAT12 XML files (Matlab)
ABIDE1_pheno <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE1_pheno_BC.rds')  # phenotypic data after step 1

ABIDE1_IQR <- ABIDE1_IQR %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = as.integer(as.character(SUB_ID)))

# Subjects in the phenotypic data without an IQR value (no usable CAT12 output)
missing_ABIDE1 <- setdiff(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID, ABIDE1_IQR$SUB_ID)
length(missing_ABIDE1)  # 10
missing_ABIDE1

ABIDE1_pheno %>%
  filter(SUB_ID %in% missing_ABIDE1) %>%
  select(SUB_ID, SITE_ID)

# Checked manually: no CAT12 output exists for these subjects (failed segmentation) -> exclude
failed_corrupt_cat12_ABIDE1 <- c(51232, 51233, 51242, 51243, 51244,
                                 51245, 51246, 51247, 51270, 51310)


ABIDE1_pheno <- ABIDE1_pheno[!ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID %in% failed_corrupt_cat12_ABIDE1, ]

sum(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID %in% failed_corrupt_cat12_ABIDE1)  # sanity check: should be 0


## ABIDE II
ABIDE2_IQR   <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/IQR/CAT12_IQR_ABIDE2.csv', header = TRUE)  # IQR values extracted from the CAT12 XML files (Matlab)
ABIDE2_pheno <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE2_pheno_BC.rds')  # phenotypic data after step 1

ABIDE2_IQR <- ABIDE2_IQR %>%
  mutate(SUB_ID = as.integer(as.character(SUB_ID)))

# IDs that appear in both IQR files = the longitudinal subjects excluded in step 1
duplicate_ids <- intersect(unique(ABIDE1_IQR$SUB_ID), unique(ABIDE2_IQR$SUB_ID))
length(duplicate_ids)  # 17
sort(duplicate_ids)

# Remove them from the ABIDE II IQR table as well (exclude_ID_long defined in step 1)
ABIDE2_IQR <- ABIDE2_IQR %>%
  filter(!SUB_ID %in% exclude_ID_long)

# Subjects in the phenotypic data without an IQR value (no CAT12 XML file)
missing_ABIDE2 <- setdiff(ABIDE2_pheno$SUB_ID, ABIDE2_IQR$SUB_ID)
missing_ABIDE2  # 3

missing_xml_ABIDE2 <- c(29013, 29895, 29617)

ABIDE2_pheno <- ABIDE2_pheno[!ABIDE2_pheno$SUB_ID %in% missing_xml_ABIDE2, ]

sum(ABIDE2_pheno$SUB_ID %in% missing_xml_ABIDE2)  # sanity check: should be 0


## IQR threshold
# Exclude scans with IQR >= 3 (worse than grade C, "satisfactory")

# ABIDE I
ABIDE1_IQR_bigger3 <- ABIDE1_IQR %>% filter(IQR >= 3)
nrow(ABIDE1_IQR_bigger3)  # 33 in the IQR file

hist(ABIDE1_IQR$IQR, breaks = 50)
abline(v = 3, lwd = 2)

# ABIDE II
ABIDE2_IQR_bigger3 <- ABIDE2_IQR %>% filter(IQR >= 3)
nrow(ABIDE2_IQR_bigger3)  # 15 in the IQR file

hist(ABIDE2_IQR$IQR, breaks = 50)
abline(v = 3, lwd = 2)

# How many of these are still in the phenotypic data
# (some ABIDE I subjects were already removed in earlier steps)
ABIDE1_pheno %>% filter(SUB_ID %in% ABIDE1_IQR_bigger3$SUB_ID) %>% nrow()  # 24
ABIDE2_pheno %>% filter(SUB_ID %in% ABIDE2_IQR_bigger3$SUB_ID) %>% nrow()  # 15

# Remove subjects with IQR >= 3
ABIDE1_pheno_IQR <- ABIDE1_pheno %>% anti_join(ABIDE1_IQR_bigger3, by = "SUB_ID")
ABIDE2_pheno_IQR <- ABIDE2_pheno %>% anti_join(ABIDE2_IQR_bigger3, by = "SUB_ID")

sum(ABIDE1_IQR_bigger3$SUB_ID %in% ABIDE1_pheno_IQR$SUB_ID)  # sanity check: should be 0
sum(ABIDE2_IQR_bigger3$SUB_ID %in% ABIDE2_pheno_IQR$SUB_ID)  # sanity check: should be 0

ABIDEall_pheno_IQR <- bind_rows(ABIDE1_pheno_IQR, ABIDE2_pheno_IQR)

# Saving this step
# saveRDS(ABIDE1_pheno_IQR, '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE1_pheno_IQR.rds')
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDE2_pheno_IQR, '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE2_pheno_IQR.rds')
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDEall_pheno_IQR, '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDEall_pheno_IQR.rds')
```



# 3) Visual exclusion
After the visual QC, subjects rated as "exclude" are removed from the phenotypic data.

```{r}
# Phenotypic data after step 2
ABIDE1_pheno <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE1_pheno_IQR.rds')
ABIDE2_pheno <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE2_pheno_IQR.rds')

# Exclusion tables (created manually during visual inspection of the images)
exclusions_ABIDE1 <- read_excel("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Quality Control/manual_QC_ABIDE_I_exclusions.xlsx")
exclusions_ABIDE2 <- read_excel("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Quality Control/manual_QC_ABIDE_II_exclusions.xlsx")


## ABIDE I
str(exclusions_ABIDE1)
table(exclusions_ABIDE1$`Exclusion?`, useNA = "ifany")  # all rows are exclusions
any(duplicated(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID))       # should be FALSE
any(duplicated(exclusions_ABIDE1$SUB_ID))  # should be FALSE

ABIDE1_pheno_clean <- ABIDE1_pheno[!(ABIDE1_pheno$SUB_ID %in% exclusions_ABIDE1$SUB_ID), ]

# 151 subjects in the exclusion table, 113 of them still in the data
# (the others were already removed in steps 1-2)
nrow(ABIDE1_pheno) - nrow(ABIDE1_pheno_clean)  # 113

sum(ABIDE1_pheno_clean$SUB_ID %in% exclusions_ABIDE1$SUB_ID)  # sanity check: should be 0


## ABIDE II
str(exclusions_ABIDE2)
table(exclusions_ABIDE2$`Exclusion?`, useNA = "ifany")  # all rows are exclusions
any(duplicated(ABIDE2_pheno$SUB_ID))       # should be FALSE
any(duplicated(exclusions_ABIDE2$SUB_ID))  # should be FALSE

ABIDE2_pheno_clean <- ABIDE2_pheno[!(ABIDE2_pheno$SUB_ID %in% exclusions_ABIDE2$SUB_ID), ]

# 83 subjects in the exclusion table, 68 of them still in the data
nrow(ABIDE2_pheno) - nrow(ABIDE2_pheno_clean)  # 68

sum(ABIDE2_pheno_clean$SUB_ID %in% exclusions_ABIDE2$SUB_ID)  # sanity check: should be 0

# Two further subjects with missing CAT12 output files (found during visual QC)
ABIDE2_pheno_clean <- ABIDE2_pheno_clean %>%
  filter(!SUB_ID %in% c(29903, 29748))


## Combine ABIDE I and II
ABIDEall_pheno_clean <- bind_rows(ABIDE1_pheno_clean, ABIDE2_pheno_clean)

nrow(ABIDEall_pheno_clean) == nrow(ABIDE1_pheno_clean) + nrow(ABIDE2_pheno_clean)  # sanity check: should be TRUE

#Saving this step

# saveRDS(ABIDE1_pheno_clean,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE1_pheno_after_visualQC.rds')
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDE2_pheno_clean,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE2_pheno_after_visualQC.rds')
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDEall_pheno_clean,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDEall_pheno_after_visualQC.rds')
```


# 4) FreeSurfer errors and MAD threshold on surface holes
```{r}
# Phenotypic data after step 3
ABIDE1_pheno_clean   <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE1_pheno_after_visualQC.rds')
ABIDE2_pheno_clean   <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE2_pheno_after_visualQC.rds')
ABIDEall_pheno_clean <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDEall_pheno_after_visualQC.rds')

# FreeSurfer aseg output (includes SurfaceHoles)
aseg_stats_ABIDE1 <- read.delim('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/ABIDE1_new/aseg_stats.txt', header = TRUE)
aseg_stats_ABIDE2 <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Data/OutputFreeSurfer/ABIDE2/aseg_volume_table_ALLSITES_combined_final.csv', header = TRUE)

colnames(aseg_stats_ABIDE1)[1] <- "SUB_ID"
colnames(aseg_stats_ABIDE2)[1] <- "SUB_ID"

# Add a dataset column 
aseg_stats_ABIDE1  <- aseg_stats_ABIDE1  %>% mutate(dataset = "ABIDE1")
aseg_stats_ABIDE2  <- aseg_stats_ABIDE2  %>% mutate(dataset = "ABIDE2")
ABIDE1_pheno_clean <- ABIDE1_pheno_clean %>% mutate(dataset = "ABIDE1")
ABIDE2_pheno_clean <- ABIDE2_pheno_clean %>% mutate(dataset = "ABIDE2")

colnames(aseg_stats_ABIDE1)[1] <- "SUB_ID"
colnames(aseg_stats_ABIDE2)[1] <- "SUB_ID"


#lets first exclude those that had a freesurfer error (according to Jente)
fs_errors <- c(29733, 29740, 28682, 50049, 29759, 29742, 29746, 29736, 29741, 29599)

sum(fs_errors %in% ABIDEall_pheno_clean$SUB_ID)  # 4 still in the data, the rest were already excluded

ABIDE1_pheno_clean <- ABIDE1_pheno_clean %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% fs_errors)
ABIDE2_pheno_clean <- ABIDE2_pheno_clean %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% fs_errors)
aseg_stats_ABIDE1  <- aseg_stats_ABIDE1  %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% fs_errors)
aseg_stats_ABIDE2  <- aseg_stats_ABIDE2  %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% fs_errors)

# sanity checks: should all be empty
fs_errors[fs_errors %in% aseg_stats_ABIDE1$SUB_ID]
fs_errors[fs_errors %in% aseg_stats_ABIDE2$SUB_ID]
fs_errors[fs_errors %in% ABIDE1_pheno_clean$SUB_ID]
fs_errors[fs_errors %in% ABIDE2_pheno_clean$SUB_ID]


## Align FreeSurfer output with the cleaned phenotypic data
# ABIDE I: keep only FreeSurfer rows of subjects that survived steps 1-3, and add their site
ABIDE1_aseg_clean <- aseg_stats_ABIDE1 %>%
  filter(SUB_ID %in% ABIDE1_pheno_clean$SUB_ID) %>%
  left_join(ABIDE1_pheno_clean %>% select(SUB_ID, SITE_ID), by = "SUB_ID")

all(ABIDE1_aseg_clean$SUB_ID %in% ABIDE1_pheno_clean$SUB_ID)  # sanity check: should be TRUE

nrow(aseg_stats_ABIDE1)   # all FreeSurfer rows: 1087
nrow(ABIDE1_aseg_clean)   # FreeSurfer rows after alignment: 933
nrow(ABIDE1_pheno_clean)  # subjects in phenotypic data: 934

# Subjects in the phenotypic data without FreeSurfer output -> exclude (50023)
missing_ABIDE1 <- setdiff(ABIDE1_pheno_clean$SUB_ID, aseg_stats_ABIDE1$SUB_ID)
missing_ABIDE1

ABIDE1_pheno_clean <- ABIDE1_pheno_clean %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% missing_ABIDE1)


# ABIDE II: same procedure
ABIDE2_aseg_clean <- aseg_stats_ABIDE2 %>%
  filter(SUB_ID %in% ABIDE2_pheno_clean$SUB_ID) %>%
  left_join(ABIDE2_pheno_clean %>% select(SUB_ID, SITE_ID), by = "SUB_ID")

all(ABIDE2_aseg_clean$SUB_ID %in% ABIDE2_pheno_clean$SUB_ID)  # sanity check: should be TRUE

nrow(aseg_stats_ABIDE2)   # all FreeSurfer rows: 1116
nrow(ABIDE2_aseg_clean)   # FreeSurfer rows after alignment: 1019
nrow(ABIDE2_pheno_clean)  # subjects in phenotypic data: 1022

# Subjects in the phenotypic data without FreeSurfer output -> exclude (29297, 29303, 29749)
missing_ABIDE2 <- setdiff(ABIDE2_pheno_clean$SUB_ID, aseg_stats_ABIDE2$SUB_ID)
missing_ABIDE2

ABIDE2_pheno_clean <- ABIDE2_pheno_clean %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% missing_ABIDE2)



## MAD threshold on SurfaceHoles, per site
sum(is.na(ABIDE1_aseg_clean$SITE_ID))  # sanity check: should be 0
sum(is.na(ABIDE2_aseg_clean$SITE_ID))  # sanity check: should be 0

sum(is.na(ABIDE1_aseg_clean$SurfaceHoles))  # subjects without a SurfaceHoles value
sum(is.na(ABIDE2_aseg_clean$SurfaceHoles))

xall <- bind_rows(
  ABIDE1_aseg_clean %>% filter(!is.na(SurfaceHoles)),
  ABIDE2_aseg_clean %>% filter(!is.na(SurfaceHoles))
)

# Exclude subjects with SurfaceHoles > median + 3 * MAD of their site
ABIDE_sitewise_all <- xall %>%
  group_by(dataset, SITE_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    median_sw = median(SurfaceHoles, na.rm = TRUE),
    mad_sw    = mad(SurfaceHoles, na.rm = TRUE),
    mad3_sw   = median_sw + 3 * mad_sw,
    keep      = SurfaceHoles <= mad3_sw
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ABIDE_final_sitewise_all <- ABIDE_sitewise_all %>% filter(keep)

excluded_ids <- ABIDE_sitewise_all %>%
  filter(!keep) %>%
  pull(SUB_ID) %>%
  unique()

excluded_sitewise <- nrow(xall) - nrow(ABIDE_final_sitewise_all)
excluded_sitewise  # 92


# Apply the same exclusions to the phenotypic data
ABIDE1_pheno_sitewise_clean <- ABIDE1_pheno_clean %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% excluded_ids)
ABIDE2_pheno_sitewise_clean <- ABIDE2_pheno_clean %>% filter(!SUB_ID %in% excluded_ids)

sum(ABIDE1_pheno_sitewise_clean$SUB_ID %in% excluded_ids)  # sanity check: should be 0
sum(ABIDE2_pheno_sitewise_clean$SUB_ID %in% excluded_ids)  # sanity check: should be 0

ABIDEall_pheno_sitewise <- bind_rows(ABIDE1_pheno_sitewise_clean, ABIDE2_pheno_sitewise_clean)

# Saving the data
# saveRDS(ABIDE_final_sitewise_all, '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE_final_sitewise_all.rds')
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDE1_pheno_sitewise_clean,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE1_pheno_sitewise_clean.rds' )
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDE2_pheno_sitewise_clean,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE2_pheno_sitewise_clean.rds' )
# 
# saveRDS(ABIDEall_pheno_sitewise,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDEall_pheno_sitewise.rds' )
```

# 5) QOALA 
Automated QC of the FreeSurfer output with the Qoala-T model (Klapwijk et al., 2019).
The first part follows the original Qoala-T script. Subjects with a Qoala-T score < 40 are excluded.

```{r QOALA}
# Packages needed by the Qoala-T model
packages <- c("caret", "corrplot", "gbm", "plyr", "randomForest", "e1071",
              "pROC", "dplyr", "pbkrtest", "car", "doParallel", "ROSE", "repmis", "ggplot2", "readr")
if (length(setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages()))) > 0) {
  install.packages(setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages())))
}
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

outputFolder <- '/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Output_Qoala_T'
if (!dir.exists(outputFolder)) dir.create(outputFolder)

dataset_name <- "ABIDE"

# FreeSurfer stats of all subjects (output of Stats2Table, see
# https://github.com/Qoala-T/QC/blob/master/Scripts/Stats2Table/Stats2Table.R)
test_data <- read.csv('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/FreeSurfer/FreeSurfer_Output_ABIDE.csv',
                      header = TRUE)

# Phenotypic data after step 1 (used to add the site to each prediction)
ABIDEall_pheno <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDEall_pheno_BC.rds')


## Run the Qoala-T model (trained on the BrainTime data)
rf.tune <- get(load(url("https://github.com/Qoala-T/QC/blob/master/Qoala_T_model.Rdata?raw=true")))

# Keep only the variables the model uses, and only complete cases
dataset_colnames <- names(rf.tune$trainingData)[-ncol(rf.tune$trainingData)]
testing <- test_data[, dataset_colnames]
keep    <- complete.cases(testing)
testing <- testing[keep, ]
rownames(testing) <- test_data$SUB_ID[keep]  # use subject IDs as row names

rf.pred  <- predict(rf.tune, testing)                # include / exclude
rf.probs <- predict(rf.tune, testing, type = "prob") # probability of each class
head(rf.probs)

# plyr is only needed by the model. Detatch it because otherwise it causes issues later on
detach("package:plyr")


## Collect the predictions
Qoala_T_predictions <- data.frame(
  participant_id    = rownames(rf.probs),
  Scan_QoalaT       = rf.probs$Include * 100,
  Recommendation    = rf.pred,
  manual_QC_adviced = ifelse(rf.probs$Include * 100 < 70 & rf.probs$Include * 100 > 30, "yes", "no")
)
Qoala_T_predictions <- Qoala_T_predictions[order(Qoala_T_predictions$Scan_QoalaT,
                                                 Qoala_T_predictions$participant_id), ]

write.csv(Qoala_T_predictions,
          file = file.path(outputFolder, paste0("Qoala_T_predictions_model_based_", dataset_name, ".csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Add the site to each prediction
Qoala_T_predictions$participant_id <- trimws(as.character(Qoala_T_predictions$participant_id))
ABIDEall_pheno$SUB_ID              <- trimws(as.character(ABIDEall_pheno$SUB_ID))

Qoala_T_predictions <- Qoala_T_predictions %>%
  left_join(ABIDEall_pheno %>% select(SUB_ID, SITE_ID),
            by = c("participant_id" = "SUB_ID"))

sum(Qoala_T_predictions$participant_id %in% ABIDEall_pheno$SUB_ID)  # 2162
sum(is.na(Qoala_T_predictions$SITE_ID))  # 28: subjects already excluded in step 1 (longitudinal / coverage)


## Apply a custom threshold of 40
Qoala_T_predictions$Recommendation_custom4 <-
  ifelse(Qoala_T_predictions$Scan_QoalaT >= 40, "Include", "Exclude")

excluded_ids_custom4 <- Qoala_T_predictions$participant_id[
  Qoala_T_predictions$Recommendation_custom4 == "Exclude"]
length(excluded_ids_custom4)  # 241 in the full (uncleaned) dataset

# Data after step 4
ABIDE_final_sitewise_all <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE_final_sitewise_all.rds')
ABIDE_pheno_sitewise_all <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDEall_pheno_sitewise.rds')

overlap_ids_custom4 <- excluded_ids_custom4[excluded_ids_custom4 %in% ABIDE_final_sitewise_all$SUB_ID]
length(overlap_ids_custom4)  # 120 still in the cleaned data -> exclude

ABIDEall_aseg_afterQOALA  <- ABIDE_final_sitewise_all[!(ABIDE_final_sitewise_all$SUB_ID %in% excluded_ids_custom4), ]
ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA <- ABIDE_pheno_sitewise_all[!(ABIDE_pheno_sitewise_all$SUB_ID %in% excluded_ids_custom4), ]


# Save this step
# write_csv(ABIDEall_aseg_afterQOALA,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/ABIDEall_aseg_afterQOALA.csv')
# write_csv(ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA,'/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA.csv')

# Plot: threshold 50 (default) vs. 40, in the cleaned sample
library(patchwork)

ABIDE_final_sitewise_all <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/ABIDE_final_sitewise_all.rds')

# restrict to the cleaned dataset
qoala_clean <- Qoala_T_predictions %>%
  filter(participant_id %in% as.character(ABIDE_final_sitewise_all$SUB_ID))

nrow(qoala_clean)  # check: should match the cleaned sample

make_qoala_plot <- function(df, threshold, panel_label) {
  df$Rec <- factor(ifelse(df$Scan_QoalaT >= threshold, "Include", "Exclude"),
                   levels = c("Exclude", "Include"))
  n_excl <- sum(df$Rec == "Exclude")
  n_incl <- sum(df$Rec == "Include")

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Scan_QoalaT, y = 1, colour = Rec)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 30, xmax = 70, ymin = 0.85, ymax = 1.15,
             alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_jitter(alpha = 0.6, height = 0.1, width = 0, size = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 1.22, hjust = 0, size = 2.5,
             label = paste0("Excluded = ", n_excl)) +
    annotate("text", x = 98, y = 1.22, hjust = 1, size = 2.5,
             label = paste0("Included = ", n_incl)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Exclude = "#CF4A30", Include = "#88A825"),
                        name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.82, 1.26)) +
    labs(x = "Qoala-T score", y = NULL,
         title = panel_label,
         subtitle = paste0("Threshold = ", threshold)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}

p50 <- make_qoala_plot(qoala_clean, 50, "a")
p40 <- make_qoala_plot(qoala_clean, 40, "b")

p_qoala <- (p50 / p40) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/Qoala_clean_50_vs_40.png',
       p_qoala, width = 16, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```

# Merging sites that contributed to both ABIDE I and ABIDE II (sometimes the name varies)
```{r}
# Data after step 5
ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA.rds')

unique(ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA$SITE_ID)

# Sites that scanned for both ABIDE I and ABIDE II (ABIDE website) are merged into one site:
#   KKI    + ABIDEII-KKI_1
#   NYU    + ABIDEII-NYU_1
#   SDSU   + ABIDEII-SDSU_1
#   UCLA_1 + ABIDEII-UCLA_1
#   USM    + ABIDEII-USM_1
#   TCD    + ABIDEII-TCD_1

ABIDEall_pheno_mergedsites <- ABIDEall_pheno_afterQOALA %>%
  mutate(
    SITE_ID = case_when(
      SITE_ID %in% c("KKI",    "ABIDEII-KKI_1")  ~ "KKI_merged",
      SITE_ID %in% c("NYU",    "ABIDEII-NYU_1")  ~ "NYU_merged",
      SITE_ID %in% c("TCD",    "ABIDEII-TCD_1")  ~ "TCD_merged",
      SITE_ID %in% c("SDSU",   "ABIDEII-SDSU_1") ~ "SDSU_merged",
      SITE_ID %in% c("UCLA_1", "ABIDEII-UCLA_1") ~ "UCLA_1_merged",
      SITE_ID %in% c("USM",    "ABIDEII-USM_1")  ~ "USM_merged",
      TRUE ~ SITE_ID
    )
  )

table(ABIDEall_pheno_mergedsites$SITE_ID)  # subjects per site after merging
```

# 6) Comorbidities, age and sex ratio per site
```{r}

# Data after site merging
ABIDEall_pheno_merged <- readRDS('/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Scripts/R Studio/data/data_final/ABIDEall_pheno_merged.rds')


## Comorbidities
# ABIDE I stores comorbidities in COMORBIDITY, ABIDE II in NONASD_PSYDX_LABEL -> combine into one column
ABIDEall_pheno_merged <- ABIDEall_pheno_merged %>%
  mutate(COMORBIDITY = coalesce(COMORBIDITY, NONASD_PSYDX_LABEL)) %>%
  select(-NONASD_PSYDX_LABEL)

# Harmonise missing values: empty strings and "none" -> NA
x <- trimws(ABIDEall_pheno_merged$COMORBIDITY)
x[x == "" | tolower(x) == "none"] <- NA
ABIDEall_pheno_merged$COMORBIDITY <- x

sum(is.na(ABIDEall_pheno_merged$COMORBIDITY))  # 1536 without comorbidity
sort(table(ABIDEall_pheno_merged$COMORBIDITY), decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]  # most frequent comorbidities

# Comorbidities per site
ABIDE_table_diagnosis <- ABIDEall_pheno_merged %>%
  group_by(SITE_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Comorbidity      = sum(!is.na(COMORBIDITY)),
    Control          = sum(DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Diagnostic_Group = sum(DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total            = n()
  )
ABIDE_table_diagnosis

# Exclude controls with a psychiatric diagnosis
sum(ABIDEall_pheno_merged$DX_GROUP == 2 & !is.na(ABIDEall_pheno_merged$COMORBIDITY))  # 22

ABIDEall_pheno_merged <- ABIDEall_pheno_merged %>%
  filter(!(DX_GROUP == 2 & !is.na(COMORBIDITY)))


## Age and sex per site (participants aged <= 30.5 years)
ABIDE_under30_overview <- ABIDEall_pheno_merged %>%
  filter(AGE_AT_SCAN <= 30.5) %>%
  group_by(SITE_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Male_Autism    = sum(SEX == 1 & DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Male_Control   = sum(SEX == 1 & DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Female_Autism  = sum(SEX == 2 & DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Female_Control = sum(SEX == 2 & DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total          = n()
  )

# Plot group sizes per site with possible cut-offs (3, 5, 10)
overview_long <- ABIDE_under30_overview %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Male_Autism, Male_Control, Female_Autism, Female_Control),
               names_to = "Group", values_to = "Count")

p_sites <- ggplot(overview_long, aes(SITE_ID, Count, fill = Group)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, 5, 10)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
p_sites

ggsave("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/ABIDEu30_site_female_cutoffs.pdf",
       plot = p_sites, width = 12, height = 6)

# Keep sites with at least 3 participants in every sex x diagnosis group
site_ok <- with(ABIDE_under30_overview,
                Male_Autism >= 3 & Male_Control >= 3 & Female_Autism >= 3 & Female_Control >= 3)

valid_sites_gender <- ABIDE_under30_overview$SITE_ID[site_ok]
sum(site_ok)                                 # number of sites kept
sum(ABIDE_under30_overview$Total[site_ok]) # number of participants kept
included_sites <- ABIDE_under30_overview$SITE_ID[site_ok]
included_sites

# excluded sites
excluded_sites <- ABIDE_under30_overview$SITE_ID[!site_ok]
excluded_sites

## Final sample
ABIDEall_filtered_under30 <- ABIDEall_pheno_merged %>%
  filter(AGE_AT_SCAN <= 30.5,
         SITE_ID %in% valid_sites_gender)

# Overview per site
ABIDE_final_overview_per_site <- ABIDEall_filtered_under30 %>%
  group_by(SITE_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Control_total = sum(DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Autism_total  = sum(DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total         = n()
  )
ABIDE_final_overview_per_site

# Overall overview
ABIDE_final_overview_total <- ABIDEall_filtered_under30 %>%
  summarise(
    Control_total  = sum(DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Autism_total   = sum(DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Male_Autism    = sum(SEX == 1 & DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Male_Control   = sum(SEX == 1 & DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Female_Autism  = sum(SEX == 2 & DX_GROUP == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Female_Control = sum(SEX == 2 & DX_GROUP == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total          = n()
  )
ABIDE_final_overview_total

## Figure for the thesis: age distribution before the age cut-off
theme_apa <- function(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.position  = "top",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(size = base_size, hjust = 0),
      panel.grid       = element_blank()
    )
}

age_cutoff <- 30  # dashed line in the plot (the filter itself uses <= 30.5)

pheno_plot <- ABIDEall_pheno_merged %>%
  mutate(
    Diagnosis = factor(DX_GROUP, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Autism", "Control")),
    Sex       = factor(SEX,      levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

p_age <- ggplot(pheno_plot, aes(x = AGE_AT_SCAN, fill = Diagnosis)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0, closed = "left",
                 colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = age_cutoff, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ Sex, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Autism = "grey30", Control = "grey80")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, 10), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))) +
  labs(x = "Age at scan (years)", y = "Number of participants") +
  theme_apa()
p_age

ggsave("/Volumes/g_psyplafor_methlab$/Students/Katharina_Bremer/Output/Plots/ABIDE_age_distribution_thesis.pdf",
       plot = p_age, width = 6.5, height = 5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```
